name: Emily Szemeredi
original_name: エミリー・セメレディ
source:
[i]"If I eat this Napolitan spaghetti, my happiness will increase by 30 percent."[/i]

[i]Calm Companion[/i]

The heroine's roommate. She calmly analyzes her own emotions and has the somewhat strange habit of quantifying them with numbers. She owns the same picture book as the heroine, so they feel a mysterious connection to each other.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/recordnoah/english/characters/?page=emily]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
